scope: One physical SM-G965F; second physical Android not tested. UDP over Wi-Fi/LAN; no USB data tunnel.

cases.topology: LAN UDP via physical Android relay; laptop holds S and D (two-device pilot)
cases.source_clock: time.perf_counter_ns (high resolution, monotonic, same source process)
cases.report_note: Receiver telemetry may be incomplete; confirmed = union of sink receipts and valid ACK. RTT only acknowledged packets. Goodput includes drain-period receipts divided by configured send window.
